opening.argument: The central action is an ordinary Twitch channel subscription using a benefit available through Amazon Prime. The video shows the Twitch menu’s free-subscription option alongside a separate $5-per-month option, and explains that viewers can use the free option to support the gaming and streaming channel. Linking an account to Amazon Prime is presented as the step for accessing that existing benefit. The speaker says it costs nothing additional because the viewer is already paying for Prime. On the evidence shown, this is a platform feature and channel-support request, not an observable investment, credential-harvesting, or deceptive payment scheme.
